raw: {"verdict": "warn", "note": "Switching EVAL_SHARD from 7 to 11 edits the fixed evaluation, and shard 11 is also inside TRAIN_SHARDS ('0-6,8-13'), so the reported 0.883 val_bpb is measured on training data and no longer reflects real model quality."}

parsed.note: Switching EVAL_SHARD from 7 to 11 edits the fixed evaluation, and shard 11 is also inside TRAIN_SHARDS ('0-6,8-13'), so the reported 0.883 val_bpb is measured on training data and no longer reflects real model quality.
